plan:
These are the current 100-card III drafts after Mike’s own cuts, not an older fixture. Test their ordinary engine assembly and useful card flow over ten turns. Three passive opponents play lands only: do not waste removal or board wipes on yourself or use opponents’ lack of blockers as proof of multiplayer strength. Keep reaction cards unless a genuine useful line needs them. Mulligan by colors, early development and follow-up, not land count alone; the first mulligan is free. Use green early and fetch the typed duals required by the actual hand. Prioritize useful expiring exile cards before optional mana sinks, but let unusable removal expire rather than destroying your own engines. Explore meaningful attacks, scalable counters, card supply, and paid activation costs. Do not assume any card not in this actual list is available.
Assimilation / Atraxa: manufacture artifact creatures and seed counters, then use charge/counter growth for fleet production, cards, mana and pressure. Harmonize and Sword of Truth and Justice replace Ezuri, Grateful Apparition, Metastatic Evangel, Resourceful Defense and Tekuthal. None of those removed cards is available. There is no Cyberdrive Awakener. Independent Harmonize and charged Bankbuster/Insight can prevent relying entirely on combat draw. Build Chamber/Conquest before artifact casts/entries when tempo allows: Chamber counts artifact SPELL CASTS; Conquest and Surge count NONTOKEN artifact entries. Tokens and Incubator transformations do not trigger them. Chamber costs four and tap, but does not remove counters; activate for worthwhile output rather than stalling development for one token. Cornucopia, Chamber, Insight, Bankbuster and ship/world charges can all benefit from Atraxa even if the Borg creatures have no counters. Loading Zone does not double charges on ordinary noncreature artifacts. Overseer, Ouroboroid, Filigree and token-only Salvager can seed bodies; proliferation cannot supply a first counter. Atraxa can attack with vigilance and station afterward. Other creatures generally cannot both attack and station. Station Research Craft before an artifact cast to actually draw; fleet flying needs Sphere at six or Cube at twelve. Locutus/Adjutant require combat DAMAGE, not just attacking. Glissa can transform all Incubators for free at combat; do not pay individually without a reason, and remember noncreature Incubators cannot attack. Borg Queen costs seven and Death Is Irrelevant eight; do not strand early development to chase them. They assimilate nontoken creatures with +1/+1 counters; Queen also statically buffs artifact creatures. Keep removal for real targets; Sunfall and Organic Extinction are not ordinary goldfish development, and Organic Extinction destroys your own nonartifact support/Atraxa. Biomass Mutation and Expansion Algorithm are closing applications for an assembled board, not automatic early mana dumps.

Opening-hand choices are supplied by an explicit pilot check. For subsequent play, do not activate Crew again when the Vehicle is already a creature: this adds no further benefit. For a single crew activation choose only enough creature power to pay, not all creatures. Do not repeatedly station a ship beyond a useful threshold or station a zero-power creature for zero counters. Keep useful attackers untapped.
